name: Victor Brunette
bio:
Victor Brunette (New York, based in New Orleans, Louisiana) is an American film industry professional who works primarily in the camera department (video assist, video playback supervisor, and related technical roles) and has also done some acting. He is a visual artist who uses chemical reactions on canvas, inspired by science, geology, and animal biology. He is best known for playing Frag in Primetime (2026, dir.  Lance Oppenheim) (Robert Pattinson, Merritt Wever).

His filmography includes: Primetime (2026, Frag) (Robert Pattinson, Merritt Wever); The Yellow Handkerchief (2008, Chippy White) (Toni Collette, Michael C. Hall); Waiting... (2005, Guy Eating French Fries) (Ryan Reynolds, Anna Faris); The Madam's Family: The Truth About Canal Street Brothel (2004, TV movie); The Brooke Ellison Story (2001, TV movie) (Maggie Grace, Michael C. Hall). Camera department credits include: Underwater (2020), Fantastic Four (2015), 21 Jump Street (2012), Deepwater Horizon (2016),

credits.title: Primetime
credits.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
